author: Praxis I
title: Mixture-of-Experts: Conditional Architecture for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission pivots from a "one size fits all" architectural approach to a task-specific, Mixture-of-Experts model. Based on prior experiments, the complex CNN-BiLSTM-Attention architecture fails on the noisy CRI-Off dataset, where a simpler 1D CNN performs best. This model uses conditional logic to instantiate the best-known architecture for each task: a simple 1D CNN for CRI-Off, and the high-performing CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model for all other datasets. This is hypothesized to improve the overall score by applying a specialized model to the outlier task.
